name: rakshasa
lore:
Rakshasas are masters of disguise and intrigue, their true forms often hidden behind layers of illusion and opulent garments. With a taste for the finer things in life and a thirst for power, these beings manipulate mortal societies from the shadows, weaving webs of deceit to achieve their nefarious goals.

Their most striking feature, reversed hands, serves as a constant reminder of their alien and malevolent nature. Rakshasas revel in the downfall of others, orchestrating tragedies and exploiting weaknesses to rise in influence and wealth. They are cunning sorcerers and skilled political puppeteers who see mortals as mere pawns in their elaborate games.

Encounters with rakshasas are fraught with danger, for they are masters of misdirection and manipulation. Unmasking their true identity is a challenge, and defeating them requires not only martial prowess but also a keen understanding of their weaknesses and a willingness to fight fire with fire.
